description: Manifest of current reference data versions. Bahi and other .khata implementations fetch this file to check for updates and verify dataset hashes.

gst-rates.note: Synced 2026-10-04 from odoo (tools/sync_upstream.py): 8 rows, 8 hand-verified overrides.

hsn-common.note: Goods rates parsed from CBIC Notifications 9/2025 (GST 2.0, 2025-09-22) and 19/2025 (2026-02-01) by tools/parse_rate_notification.py, with pre-2025 rates from the 2023 schedule. Codes under more than one rate are conditional (no automatic rate). Nil goods (10/2025) and services changes (15/2025) not parsed. Provenance: provenance/2026-10-04-gst-2-0-rates/.

hsn-full.note: Synced 2026-10-04 from india-compliance (tools/sync_upstream.py): 18687 rows, 0 hand-verified overrides.

sac.note: Starter set of major service categories; needs expansion

cess.note: Compensation cess ended for all goods: non-tobacco on 2025-09-22 (02/2025-CC(Rate)), pan masala and tobacco on 2026-02-01 (03/2025-CC(Rate)). Kept for documents dated before those days.

tds-sections.note: Synced 2026-10-04 from india-compliance (tools/sync_upstream.py): 88 rows, 14 hand-verified overrides.

tcs-sections.note: Synced 2026-10-04 from odoo (tools/sync_upstream.py): 20 rows, 20 hand-verified overrides.

challan-templates.note: Most common challans; more state-specific forms to follow

ca-corpus.note: CA-lookup RAG corpus consumed by Bahi: 181 entries (TDS/TCS, GST goods/services/RCM, income-tax basics, compliance calendar) with bge-small-en-v1.5 int8 embeddings. AI-assembled + CA-reviewed; DRAFT reference, verify before relying. Built via Bahi corpus/build.mjs.

notes: SHA-256 hashes are computed by .github/scripts/update-index.py and refreshed automatically by the publish workflow on every push that changes data/.

Status values: 'stable' means the dataset is accurate and ready for use; 'starter' means a reasonable initial set that should be reviewed and expanded; 'placeholder' means a structural skeleton that must be replaced before production use.
Implementations should treat 'placeholder' datasets with extra caution — surface to the user that the data is incomplete and they should exercise judgment on values not covered by the bundled set.
